title: Add CI workflow for typecheck, format check, tests, and viewer build
author: claude
head: 7564b14df979cbcbd3b1d53aa25c79965da96a41
body:
## What

Adds `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the repository's first CI. On every push to `main` and every pull request it runs, on Node 22:

1. `npm ci`
2. `npm run typecheck`
3. `npm run format:check`
4. `npm run test:run`
5. `npm run build:viewer`

Details:

- `permissions: contents: read` only.
- `actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node` are pinned to commit SHAs (v7.0.1 and v7.0.0), with npm caching.
- A guard step makes sure the `sqlite3` CLI is present, since `tests/cli/db.test.ts` shells out to it (it is preinstalled on `ubuntu-latest`, so this is normally a no-op).
- Superseded runs on the same pull request are cancelled; runs on `main` are never cancelled, so every main commit keeps its result.

## Lockfile fix

`package-lock.json` only carried the `darwin-arm64` binaries for rollup and esbuild (npm/cli#4828), so `npm ci` on a Linux runner installed no native binary and `vitest` / `vite build` failed with `Cannot find module @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu`. This PR records the missing `@rollup/rollup-*@4.54.0` and `@esbuild/*@0.27.2` optional platform entries — same versions as already locked, no other package changed (719 added lines, 0 removed).

## Why

Nothing has checked a commit since January and outside contributors get no signal on their pull requests. This also makes "pull requests with passing checks" measurable.

## Checks run locally (clean `npm ci`, Node 22.22.0, Linux x64)

- `npm run typecheck` — pass
- `npm run format:check` — pass (includes the new workflow file and lockfile)
- `npm run test:run` — 10 files, 159 tests pass (with `sqlite3` 3.45.1 installed)
- `npm run build:viewer` — builds `templates/index.html`

Not in scope here, possible follow-up: CI does not run `build:ts` or `build:skill`, so a broken `npm run build` (the `prepublishOnly` path) would still only surface at release time.
